items.name: Monospace from Directus
items.tagline: The governed API layer for every app, person, and agent
items.description: Monospace sits between enterprise data and everyone who builds on it. Connect any data source, and your developers, business teams, and AI agents get live, read-write access to it. All under the same granular permissions model, with no data copied or moved. Your oldest databases weren't built with AI or modern apps in mind. Monospace generates interfaces directly from them, as they are, introspecting the schema and queries in real time, so they don’t need to be rebuilt.

items.name: Yedric.ai
items.tagline: Let users control your SaaS with natural language
items.description: Your users shouldn't have to learn where every feature lives. Yedric adds an embeddable AI agent to your SaaS that turns natural-language requests into actions your product already knows how to perform. Users simply say what they want done and Yedric handles the interaction. Instead of building and maintaining your own agent experience, developers can make their existing product AI-native in under 30 minutes.

items.name: Dots by OpenAI
items.tagline: Always on agents built to handle everything
items.description: Dots are always on agents in ChatGPT, powered by GPT‑6 Astra. Each dot has its own cloud computer and browser, connects to over 4,000 apps through plugins, and can work toward your goals 24/7. Message or call your dot in ChatGPT on desktop, web, and mobile, or message it in Slack and Teams. It learns your preferences from feedback and brings you finished work to review. Custom Rules, Activity View, and auto review keep you in control. Rolling out now to Pro and Business Premium.

items.name: Omnia Agent
items.tagline: The AI Agent that does 95% of your GEO work
items.description: Every brand needs to show up in AI search. Now yours can, without hiring a GEO expert. Omnia Agent finds the prompts where your competitors are winning, then wins them for you with skills built for GEO. It plugs into the tools you already use, so every action you approve goes live with no extra work.

items.name: Polylane
items.tagline: AI agents that fix production before you wake up
items.description: Nobody should be on call. Polylane connects your code, infra and observability data, investigates every incident and opens a pull request with the fix. If code can't fix it, you get the root cause and a recommendation.

items.name: DSH Desktop
items.tagline: Official app for DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness
items.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop is the official Mac and Windows app for DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness. Install it, sign in, and run everyday work, coding, and scheduled tasks locally with the same plugin system as the CLI.

items.name: statusbar
items.tagline: a statusbar for any terminal
items.description: A status bar for any terminal.

items.name: Chat.sh
items.tagline: The help center I built after Intercom's search broke
items.description: 🎉 Launch day only: $200 off any lifetime deal with code PHLAUNCH ($399 → $199, $799 → $599). Ends Oct 2, 12 AM PT. Most help centers give you a subdomain, a keyword search, and a monthly bill. chat.sh is different: 🔍 AI search that writes the answer and cites the pages it used 📁 Lives in a folder on your own site (yoursite.com/help) 🤖 Every page as markdown for ChatGPT, Claude, and llms.txt 💸 Pay once, no subscription Try it at chat.sh/help. Chat messenger and a support inbox are next.

items.name: Bracket
items.tagline: The memory layer for your business
items.description: Bracket turns the conversations already happening across your business into a living, continuously updated memory. Connect Gmail, Slack, Figma and GitHub, or add meeting notes and transcripts. Bracket automatically captures requirements, decisions, scope, deliverables, deadlines and changes as they happen. Then ask Bracket about anything that happened or generate replies using the full context. No more manually keeping another tool up to date.

items.name: America.gov
items.tagline: Whatever you need from government, start here.
items.description: America.gov is the simplest, fastest way to get information from the U.S. government. Instead of hunting across agency websites, just ask a question in plain language and get a clear answer. Built by the National Design Studio with the General Services Administration, it brings every federal agency together in one place. Available in English, French, and Spanish. Coming next: apply, enroll, and track progress right in chat.

items.name: Starlie
items.tagline: A fast, native Jira client for Mac
items.description: Starlie is for the Jira work you do every day: find an issue, see what’s going on, update it, leave a comment, move it across the board, and get back to work. Smooth Kanban drag and drop, quick filters, JQL autocomplete, custom fields, Quick Look, reminders, and ⌘K for recent issues. Works with Jira Cloud and self-hosted Jira too. Private by design, with no analytics or tracking. Open coding tasks in Claude Code or Codex with issue context and your local project attached.

items.name: Buddy Drop
items.tagline: Drop the files, get a live URL in seconds
items.description: Buddy Drop puts your site or app online in seconds. Just drop your folder, ZIP, or files and choose from a range of free domains or connect your own. Buddy takes care of the rest, from hosting and deployment to previews and versioning. No signup required.

items.name: Helo
items.tagline: An independent email API from former Postmark folks
items.description: Helo is an email API built for developers and platforms that send on behalf of their customers. Contain bad senders before they drag down deliverability, let customers send from their own domains, and keep stats, unsubscribes, and credentials separate per tenant. It also covers the fundamentals: REST API and SMTP, SDKs in popular languages, separate transactional and broadcast infrastructure, and usage-based pricing starting at just $0.00035 per email—all features included.

items.name: Phare C1®
items.tagline: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast.
items.description: Phare C1 is a smoke alarm that sounds for actual emergencies and nothing else. Its multi-sensor array spots fire and CO early and accurately, reduces false alarms, and is backed by detection algorithms that learn and improve to make your home even safer over time. It keeps much-loved features from the Nest Protect (RIP) like early warnings, a night light, and in-app alerts, and adds new ones like air quality monitoring and intruder detection.

items.name: NotchMind
items.tagline: Put your MacBook notch to work: music, files, timers & more
items.description: NotchMind turns your MacBook notch into a home for music, files, clipboard history, timers, downloads and 28 everyday tools. Native macOS app, one-time purchase.

items.name: Vitra.ai
items.tagline: Agentic content platform to create and localize content
items.description: Stop switching tools! Vitra.ai Universe does the work of 12 tools in one place: create, translate and personalize video, images, docs and audio in 100+ languages. Dub with lip-sync, translate designs from Figma, Canva and Adobe, and adapt every creative to every size. AI agents in Vitra Flow run your workflows end to end, & your team approves. Brand kits, translation memory, & style guides keep every output on-brand. The future of Autonomous Content Operations is here Start free, no credit card.

items.name: Basedash chat dashboard preview
items.tagline: One prompt. A whole dashboard, live in your chat.
items.description: Basedash chat now builds whole dashboards from one prompt — KPIs, charts, tables, filters, and tabs — and previews them live right in the conversation. Ask for "a sales dashboard with pipeline, win rate, and revenue by rep" and it lands inline, ready to use. Change the date filter, switch tabs, then open it as a full dashboard when it looks right. Sales, support, product, finance, and ops can all start from a sentence. One prompt. A whole dashboard, live in your chat.

items.name: Clarity
items.tagline: Mute the room, keep the speaker, in real time
items.description: Real-time speech enhancement and target speaker extraction for voice agents. Clarity-1 strips out background noise and other people talking on a live call, so your agent hears only the caller. Streams as audio arrives. Hear the before/after on our site.

items.name: JevGPT
items.tagline: A chatbot built on a model that can't write
items.description: For years we've used LLMs built to write text to make choices. JevGPT returns the favor: a chat app where TypeSafe's Jev, a model built to make choices, writes every reply one multiple-choice word at a time. Does it work? Sort of. Open source.

items.name: Firetower
items.tagline: Run coding agents on your own servers, from anywhere
items.description: Run coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on infrastructure you control and manage them from desktop or mobile. It's open source, self-hostable, and built in Rust.
